$$b_n=\begin{cases}a_n, & \text{if } a_n\ge0\\ 0, & \text{if } a_n<0\end{cases}\qquad\text{and}\qquad c_n=\begin{cases}a_n, & \text{if } a_n<0\\ 0, & \text{if } a_n\ge0\end{cases}$$
for each positive integer $n$.

Which ONE of the following statements is TRUE?

choices.text: If $\sum_{n=1}^\infty a_n$ does not converge, then $\sum_{n=1}^\infty b_n$ does not converge.
If $\sum_{n=1}^\infty a_n$ converges but $\sum_{n=1}^\infty |a_n|$ does not converge, then $\sum_{n=1}^\infty b_n$ converges.
If $\sum_{n=1}^\infty a_n$ converges but $\sum_{n=1}^\infty |a_n|$ does not converge, then $\sum_{n=1}^\infty b_n$ does not converge.
If $\sum_{n=1}^\infty a_n$ converges, then $\sum_{n=1}^\infty b_n$ converges or $\sum_{n=1}^\infty c_n$ converges.

$$d(F(P),F(Q))=d(P,Q)\quad\text{for all }P,Q\in\mathbb{R}^3.$$
Which ONE of the following statements is FALSE?
